## Tempo Explore

Open [Tempo Explore](/explore?orgId=1&left=%7B%22datasource%22%3A%22tempo%22%2C%22queries%22%3A%5B%7B%22refId%22%3A%22A%22%2C%22queryType%22%3A%22traceqlSearch%22%2C%22filters%22%3A%5B%5D%7D%5D%2C%22range%22%3A%7B%22from%22%3A%22now-1h%22%2C%22to%22%3A%22now%22%7D%7D) to search recent traces.

### Common queries

- **All spans from a service**: TraceQL `{ resource.service.name = "<service>" }`
- **Slow requests**: `{ duration > 1s }`
- **Errors**: `{ status = error }`

### Trace-to-logs

Click a trace span and use the **Logs for this span** link to pivot to Loki Explore with `{service_name="<svc>"} | trace_id="<id>"` pre-applied (D-79 + D-80). The link works only for OTel-SDK-instrumented apps whose logs carry `trace_id` in structured metadata.
